item.title: Hoto: Yamanashi's Hearty Miso Noodle Hotpot — Guide
item.description: Hoto is Yamanashi’s signature soul food, a hearty hotpot dish of thick, flat, chewy wheat noodles simmered directly in a rich miso-based broth alongside pumpkin, root vegetables and other seasonal produce, traditionally served bubbling in a cast-iron pot. Unlike udon, the noodles are cooked straight in the broth without pre-boiling, thickening it as the starch releases, and the dish’s warming, filling character made it a staple of the mountainous region’s diet, historically associated with the samurai warlord Takeda Shingen’s provisions.
